# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-NOI v0.1/r0.6

Status: frozen v0.1/r0.6 compatibility/request-state scientific boundary; no
NOI realization or empirical-covariance equivalence is claimed available

Selected human title: **Matched-template map amplitude estimation**. Title and
method ID are not optimality evidence; each realization carries its exact
`optimality_status`.

FLT owns transformation and compatibility; NOI owns realization population and
membership meaning. Each signal bundle carries the NOI named-use status:
`not_requested`, `inapplicable`, `unavailable`, `compatible`,
`requested_pending`, or `realized_child_exists`.

`K_NOI(z,y)` is evaluated before Apply from declared parent class/quantity,
WCS/grid/indexing, units/calibration, template identity, resolved generation,
local/application support and missingness, stochastic-model identity and
domain, NOI authority, numerical profile, and failure policy. Compatibility
never depends on the observed payload, transformed draw, success, censoring,
pairwise deletion, or draw-dependent domain. An admitted member receives the
identical resolved template, anchors, weight, extraction, normalization, exact
application support, validity rules, profile, and failure policy. There is no
per-member Learn/Resolve.

NOI validity `V_NOI` is no broader than `V_signal`. An unrequested,
incompatible, unavailable, failed, or absent child does not narrow signal
validity or mutate the parent. Any covariance comparison binds
`h_pre=(g_resolved,theta)`, a fixed `P_C`, the exact random vector `M`, and the
authorized law on `D_model`; it never substitutes the observed numerical map
`m_obs`. The corrected product order is Requested -> Effective ->
LearnedCandidate (when Learn applies) -> Resolved -> Applied -> Realized ->
CompletePublicationCandidate -> PublicationDecided -> Published or
NotProduced, with typed alternate and failure branches.
